title: Long-term Outcome of End-stage Renal Disease Patients Treated With Hig-efficiency Hemodiafiltration
brief_summary: A retrospective cohort study was conducted in 66 end-stage renal disease patients who underwent high-efficiency hemodiafiltration technique in King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital between 2001-2013 to determine the survival rate as well as other long-term outcome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 18 years or more
* Be diagnosed end-stage renal disease for more than one year
* Have been regularly received long-term hemodiafiltration for more than 6 months.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who received hemodiafiltration less than 6 months
study_population: End-stage renal disease patients who had been received long-term hemodiafiltration at King Chulalongkorn Memorial hospital during 2001-2013
